clips.title: The story
paras: Mudsnout Blossoms grow in Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill. Mudsnout gnolls guard the foul, toxic mushrooms, and Apothecary Lydon seeks them for his elixir research.

South of Tarren Mill, Mudsnout Blossoms grow in Nethander Stead. Despite their name, they are large, foul-smelling mushrooms that flourish in soiled dirt among the local Mudsnout gnolls' camps. The gnolls defend the territory fiercely. The mushrooms' spores and flesh poison living things, causing agony and rapid bodily decay.
